title: Control assessment: account management samples
source_system: DCS, SIS, terminal and gateway user exports; driver card list (2026-08-12); HR termination and transfer reports; samples of 25 of 96 terminations, 15 of 41 transfers and 25 of 186 DCS accounts; Controls Engineering Manager and HR Director interviews
what_it_shows: 3 of 25 sampled leavers still had enabled DCS accounts 9 to 61 days after leaving and 2 leavers' loading bay driver cards were active; the controls team was not notified of 3 of 25 sampled terminations or of any of the 15 sampled transfers; operators share one account per console position; OT accounts and driver cards last reviewed 2025-11; shared console passwords changed twice a year

title: Control assessment: access enforcement test
source_system: DCS security configuration export; SIS keyswitch and download test on the Blend Hall 1 outage; recipe author role test
collected_by: Co-sourced internal audit firm (OT specialist subcontractor)
what_it_shows: The DCS rejected a setpoint write from an operator-level account; the SIS controller rejected a download with the keyswitch in run; a non-author account could not edit a recipe

title: Control assessment: least privilege
source_system: Gateway policy export; DCS role matrix; tank gauging server and dock transfer PLC role settings; console login sample 2026-08-17 to 2026-08-21
what_it_shows: 2 integrator gateway accounts had standing rights to all OT zones; the tank gauging server and dock transfer PLC have a single administrator role; 2 of 5 controls engineers used engineering accounts for routine monitoring in the sample week

title: Control assessment: remote access sessions
source_system: POL-02 4.8; gateway policy and justification records; 20 of 312 gateway sessions (2026-05 to 2026-07); 4 Shift Supervisor interviews
what_it_shows: Usage restrictions and connection requirements documented per vendor; 6 of 20 sampled sessions had no recorded authorization before connection; Shift Supervisors gave approvals by phone with no written procedure

title: Control assessment: security literacy training
source_system: Training platform reports; contractor badge list (40 active OT contractors); course content; 15 staff interviews
what_it_shows: 371 of 430 Port employees completed the USCG module by the 2026-01-12 deadline; 0 of 40 contractors with OT access have training records; content covers literacy, privacy, phishing simulations and the USCG topics and was updated 2025-12; lessons from OT events are not in the content

title: Control assessment: role-based training
source_system: Role training roster; shift supervisor crew records; vendor engineer list
what_it_shows: Role training current for the CySO, alternate and controls engineers; shift supervisors on 2 of 4 crews have no cyber incident role training; no role training records for integrator and SIS vendor engineers; no lessons learned input

title: Control assessment: audit record review
source_system: SIEM source list (2026-08-14) and review records; MSSP statement of work; OT sensor alert mailbox (2026-07); conduit log samples
what_it_shows: IT/OT conduit logs reach the SIEM with no review records; the 14 OT sensor alerts of July 2026 were read on the next business day, 3 of them more than 60 hours after being raised outside business hours; no OT review reporting to the CySO; review level unchanged after the 2026-05 Area Maritime Security Committee threat briefing

title: Control assessment: audit record protection test
source_system: SIEM role list; DCS administrator rights; test clearing of a DCS audit trail on the training station
collected_by: Co-sourced internal audit firm (OT specialist subcontractor)
what_it_shows: A DCS administrator account cleared the local audit trail on the training station and no alert was raised; DCS logs are not forwarded; SIEM access limited to the security team and the MSSP

title: Control assessment: information exchanges
source_system: 2023 OT DMZ design record; ERP order relay record; data platform feed; vendor service agreements
what_it_shows: Interface characteristics and controls documented for the ERP order relay and the historian replica; no responsibilities documented for the cloud data platform feed or the three vendor gateway connections; impact level not recorded for any exchange; no review schedule

title: Control assessment: baseline configuration
source_system: DCS baseline document 2024; terminal PLC, tank gauging and loading bay configurations; network map 2023
what_it_shows: DCS controller, server and station baselines documented and kept under MOC; no baselines for the dock transfer PLC, tank gauging server, 6 loading bay controllers or packaging PLCs; baselines not reviewed since 2024 and no review frequency set

title: Control assessment: change control sample
source_system: MOC log: 15 of 63 control system changes (2025-08 to 2026-07); 10 firewall change tickets; Process Safety Manager interview
what_it_shows: MOC records for DCS and SIS changes show review, safety and security impact questions, approval and implementation; 2 of 15 sampled control changes (dock transfer PLC timer, tank gauging alarm) had no MOC security review; terminal PLC and OT firewall changes are not defined as MOC-controlled or monitored against approved MOCs

title: Control assessment: change restriction test
source_system: SIS keyswitch procedure; SIS EWS location and logon test; SIS proof test record 2025-11-04; logic compare evidence
collected_by: Co-sourced internal audit firm (OT specialist subcontractor)
what_it_shows: Keyswitch, SIS EWS on the SIS network and named accounts held under test; running SIS logic compared with the approved copy only at the annual proof test; keyswitch position not alarmed

title: Control assessment: least functionality test
source_system: Switch port audit 2026-08-19 (Blend Hall 1, tank farm); device control report; tank gauging server service list
collected_by: Co-sourced internal audit firm (OT specialist subcontractor)
what_it_shows: 31 unused field switch ports enabled; the tank gauging server runs a web service reachable from the supervisory zone; DCS stations run only vendor-required services

title: Control assessment: component inventory walkdown
source_system: Asset register 2026-08-01; OT sensor inventory (412 assets); walkdown of Blend Hall 1 and the terminal
what_it_shows: 72 of 412 sensor-discovered assets not yet in the register; 72 reconciled devices without firmware versions; no critical IT and OT system designations; no update frequency set; reconciled entries without duplicates

title: Control assessment: contingency plan
source_system: Emergency response plan; OT contingency plan draft (2026-08); BIA (P05); Controls Engineering Manager interview
what_it_shows: Emergency response plan and BIA identify essential functions, recovery objectives and priorities; OT contingency plan in draft (due 2026-12-31) with no named vendor recovery contacts and no full DCS rebuild procedure; the draft is not yet reviewed, approved or distributed

title: Control assessment: contingency plan testing
source_system: Restore record 2025-03; test plan for 2026-11-10; restore of one historian client image during the outage
collected_by: Co-sourced internal audit firm (OT specialist subcontractor)
what_it_shows: One operator station restore on record (2025-03); no test of the OT contingency plan; a historian client image restore was run during the outage; full DCS restore test planned for 2026-11-10

title: Control assessment: backup test
source_system: Backup job logs (30 nightly jobs, July 2026); fire safe log (4 weekly copies); hash check of the latest offline copy
collected_by: Co-sourced internal audit firm (OT specialist subcontractor)
what_it_shows: Nightly and weekly backups ran on all 30 sampled days; offline copies in the fire safe; hashes of the latest offline copy matched; system-level backups do not include the dock transfer PLC, tank gauging server or loading bay controllers

title: Control assessment: recovery and reconstitution
source_system: Recovery procedure draft; spares list; DCS integrator interview
what_it_shows: Spare controller and server hardware on site; recovery procedure in draft; no tested rebuild of the DCS server pair from clean media; recovery within the 12-hour RTO not demonstrated

title: Control assessment: console identification test
source_system: DCS user export (2026-08-19); console login test
collected_by: Co-sourced internal audit firm (OT specialist subcontractor)
what_it_shows: Operator consoles sign in with one shared account per console position; console actions are not tied to an individual

title: Control assessment: privileged account MFA test
source_system: MFA sign-in test on all 41 gateway and OT administrator accounts
collected_by: Co-sourced internal audit firm (OT specialist subcontractor)
what_it_shows: All 41 privileged accounts required MFA at sign-in

title: Control assessment: authenticator tests
source_system: Default credential test on 30 Port OT devices (vendor-approved, during the outage); password settings; shared password change log
collected_by: Co-sourced internal audit firm (OT specialist subcontractor)
what_it_shows: The radar tank gauging server accepted the vendor default administrator password from the supervisory zone (1 of 30 devices tested; password changed 2026-08-20); the dock transfer PLC uses a 4-digit PIN; shared console passwords changed twice a year and not when crew members leave; a draft OT exceptions list names 3 device types that cannot meet the password rule

title: Control assessment: incident handling
source_system: IR plan 2024; P08 runbook drafts; incident register (11 incidents 2025-2026); OT sensor event emails
what_it_shows: IT incident handling with the MSSP covers preparation through recovery with lessons learned recorded; the 11 incidents in the register are all IT; OT sensor events handled by email; Inland plant events outside the incident process; the OT runbook is a draft and has not been exercised

title: Control assessment: incident reporting
source_system: FSP reporting procedures; P08 notification matrix draft; 15 staff interviews
what_it_shows: Staff report to the control room or help desk with no time limit set; 9 of 15 interviewees did not know that suspected cyber incidents must reach the CySO; FSP procedures have no report to the FBI, CISA and the COTP under 33 CFR 6.16-1

title: Control assessment: incident response assistance
source_system: MSSP contract; cyber insurance panel terms; DCS vendor incident response service schedule
what_it_shows: 24x7 MSSP support for IT, the insurer's panel for forensics and counsel, and the DCS vendor's OT incident service are under contract and known to the incident manager

title: Control assessment: incident response plan
source_system: IR plan 2024; P08 runbook and notification matrix drafts; distribution list
what_it_shows: The 2024 plan and the runbook drafts give a roadmap, structure, reportable incident definitions and designated responsibility; no incident response metrics; runbooks not distributed to shift supervisors, the MSSP or the DCS integrator; no process to communicate plan changes

title: Control assessment: nonlocal maintenance
source_system: Gateway records for 20 vendor sessions; justification records; session termination settings
what_it_shows: Remote maintenance runs only through the gateway with MFA, recording and automatic session termination; 6 of 20 vendor sessions had no recorded approval; recordings not reviewed

title: Control assessment: media use
source_system: Device control report for 52 Port OT workstations; media kiosk log
what_it_shows: USB storage allowed on 14 local HMIs in Blend Hall 1 and packaging and blocked on DCS stations; kiosk scanning in use

title: Control assessment: physical access walkdown
source_system: Badge reports for the control room, server room and rack rooms; walkdown 2026-08-19; key log
what_it_shows: Badge and TWIC controls, visitor escort and audit logs operate for the control room, OT server room and rack rooms; 4 remote I/O cabinets on keyed locks with no access log; cabinet keys unchanged since 2019

title: Control assessment: risk assessment
source_system: P01 risk register and report (2026-07-31); BIA (P05); audit committee pack
what_it_shows: The 2026 risk assessment identifies threats and vulnerabilities, rates likelihood and impact with SP 800-30 tables, and is documented and shared with the audit committee

title: Control assessment: vulnerability monitoring and KEV comparison
source_system: Quarterly IT and DMZ scan reports; OT sensor vulnerability report (2026-08); KEV comparison by the assessors
what_it_shows: IT and DMZ systems scanned quarterly and results analyzed; OT assets not compared with the KEV catalog by the company; the assessors matched 18 KEV-listed vulnerabilities to 23 Port OT assets; no OT remediation timeframes; OT vulnerability information not shared with the Inland plant or vendors

title: Control assessment: external system services
source_system: Vendor files for the DCS integrator, SIS vendor, tank gauging vendor, MSSP and 11 key SaaS vendors
what_it_shows: Security requirements in the MSSP and SaaS contracts; OT vendor contracts carry confidentiality terms only; no vendor oversight after onboarding; SOC 2 reports reviewed for 3 of 11 key SaaS vendors

title: Control assessment: boundary protection test
source_system: Firewall rule export 2026-08-14 (214 rules, all reviewed); reachability tests from the supervisory zone and the business network during the outage
collected_by: Co-sourced internal audit firm (OT specialist subcontractor)
what_it_shows: No direct path from the business network to the control zone; the DMZ separates public-facing and internal components; the tank gauging server web interface reachable from the whole supervisory zone; 7 rules broader than documented; conduit traffic logged and not monitored

title: Control assessment: flaw remediation
source_system: Turnaround patch record 2025-10; DCS vendor release notes; sensor vulnerability report
what_it_shows: Flaws identified through vendor notices and patches tested with the vendor before installation; OT patches applied only at the yearly turnaround; DCS one major release behind; 9 end-of-support workstations; no timeframe for OT software or firmware updates

title: Control assessment: system monitoring test
source_system: OT sensor configuration and alert mailbox; MSSP statement of work; simulated port scan from the supervisory zone during the outage
collected_by: Co-sourced internal audit firm (OT specialist subcontractor)
what_it_shows: The OT sensor at the Port plant core switches detected the simulated scan of 2026-08-19 and the alert was read 19 hours later; alerts analyzed in business hours only and not sent to the MSSP or the control room; field switch connections and OT account use not monitored; no OT monitoring objectives

title: Control assessment: personnel termination sample
source_system: 25 of 96 terminations (2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30); termination checklist; badge and driver card system
what_it_shows: Identity provider access disabled the same day for all 25 sampled leavers, with exit interviews and property return recorded; 3 DCS accounts and 2 driver cards not revoked at termination

title: Control assessment: notification agreements
source_system: Contracts for the DCS integrator, SIS vendor, tank gauging vendor, Inland integrator and MSSP
what_it_shows: No vulnerability or compromise notification terms with any OT vendor; the MSSP contract has one; the General Counsel's draft notice clause was examined
